meta.title: Households (Demo)
meta.description: A dashboard for a household, or for several: shared tasks and appointments, per-member profiles, the notes each house needs people to know, and a dial showing who is at which home today. Pre-loaded with three homes — two separated parents and a grandparent — and two children who belong to all of them, rotating week on and week off between the parents with a one-off day at the grandparent's (member accounts use the password "demo").
meta.author: Alex Kirk

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( ! post_type_exists( 'household' ) || ! class_exists( '\\Households\\Storage' ) ) {
	return;
}

$admin = get_user_by( 'login', 'admin' );
$admin_id = $admin ? (int) $admin->ID : 1;
$storage = new \Households\Storage();
$child = \Households\Access::ROLE_CHILD;

// Two separated parents, two homes. The children belong to both.
$home_a = $storage->create_household( "Sam's Home", $admin_id );
$home_b = $storage->create_household( "Jo's Home", $admin_id );
if ( ! $home_a || ! $home_b ) {
	return;
}
$storage->update_household( $home_a, [ 'rewards_enabled' => true ] );
$storage->update_household( $home_b, [ 'rewards_enabled' => true ] );

$sam_id  = $storage->add_member( $home_a, 'Sam', \Households\Access::ROLE_ADMIN, '', 'demo' );
$jo_id   = $storage->add_member( $home_b, 'Jo', \Households\Access::ROLE_ADMIN, '', 'demo' );
$nana_id = $storage->add_member( $home_b, 'Nana', \Households\Access::ROLE_GRANDPARENT, '', 'demo' );
$mia_id  = $storage->add_member( $home_a, 'Mia', $child, '', 'demo' );
$ben_id  = $storage->add_member( $home_a, 'Ben', $child, '', 'demo' );
\Households\Access::set_member_role( $home_b, $mia_id, $child );
\Households\Access::set_member_role( $home_b, $ben_id, $child );

$storage->add_task( $home_a, 'Pack school bag', $mia_id, 'task', 5, gmdate( 'Y-m-d' ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_a, 'Feed the cat', $ben_id, 'task', 5, gmdate( 'Y-m-d' ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_a, 'Tidy room', $mia_id, 'task', 10, gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+1 day' ) ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_a, 'Dentist appointment', $ben_id, 'appointment', 0, gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+2 days' ) ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_a, 'Parent-teacher meeting', $sam_id, 'appointment', 0, gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+4 days' ) ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_a, 'Book summer camp', 0, 'task', 0, gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+10 days' ) ) );

$storage->add_task( $home_b, 'Water the plants', $ben_id, 'task', 5, gmdate( 'Y-m-d' ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_b, 'Practice piano', $mia_id, 'task', 10, gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+1 day' ) ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_b, 'Swimming lesson', $mia_id, 'appointment', 0, gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+3 days' ) ) );
$storage->add_task( $home_b, 'Renew passports', $jo_id, 'task', 0, gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+14 days' ) ) );

$storage->add_reward( $home_a, 'Movie night pick', $mia_id, 20 );
$storage->add_reward( $home_a, 'Extra screen time', 0, 15 );
$storage->add_reward( $home_b, 'Ice cream outing', $ben_id, 25 );
$storage->add_reward( $home_b, 'Baking afternoon with Nana', 0, 30 );

$storage->save_profile( $mia_id, [ 'birthdate' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '-9 years +12 days' ) ), 'allergies' => "Peanuts\nHouse dust", 'shoe_size' => '33', 'clothing_size' => '134', 'notes' => 'Swimming on Wednesdays, needs the blue bag.' ] );
$storage->save_profile( $ben_id, [ 'birthdate' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '-6 years +80 days' ) ), 'shoe_size' => '29', 'clothing_size' => '116', 'notes' => 'Inhaler is in the kitchen drawer.' ] );
$storage->save_profile( $sam_id, [ 'birthdate' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '-38 years +200 days' ) ) ] );
$storage->save_profile( $jo_id, [ 'birthdate' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '-40 years +45 days' ) ) ] );

// A third home: the grandparent's house, which the children also belong to.
$home_c = $storage->create_household( "Nana's House", $admin_id );
\Households\Access::set_member_role( $home_c, $nana_id, \Households\Access::ROLE_ADMIN );
\Households\Access::set_member_role( $home_c, $mia_id, $child );
\Households\Access::set_member_role( $home_c, $ben_id, $child );

// The children rotate week on, week off between the two parents' homes. Nana's
// is in the rotation as a third home, used for a single day the pattern knows
// nothing about.
$monday = gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( 'monday this week' ) );
foreach ( [ $mia_id, $ben_id ] as $kid_id ) {
	\Households\Whereabouts::save_rotation( $kid_id, [
		'pattern'         => \Households\Whereabouts::PATTERN_WEEK,
		'start_date'      => $monday,
		'homes'           => [ $home_a, $home_b, $home_c ],
		'changeover_time' => '17:00',
	] );
	\Households\Whereabouts::set_override( $kid_id, gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( $monday . ' +9 days' ) ), $home_c );
}

// The things people ask about a house they are not in every day.
$storage->add_household_info( $home_a, 'Wifi', 'Network "sams-wifi", password on the fridge door' );
$storage->add_household_info( $home_a, 'Water main valve', 'Under the stairs, behind the coats' );
$storage->add_household_info( $home_a, 'Bin day', 'Paper on Tuesday, everything else on Friday' );
$storage->add_household_info( $home_b, 'Wifi', 'Network "jos-flat", password taped under the router' );
$storage->add_household_info( $home_b, 'Spare key', 'With the neighbour in flat 3' );
$storage->add_household_info( $home_c, 'Wifi', 'Network "nana", ask Nana' );
$storage->add_household_info( $home_c, 'Doctor', 'Practice on the square, closed Wednesday afternoons' );

$storage->add_points( $mia_id, 15 );
$storage->add_points( $ben_id, 5 );
